descricao: Little is known concerning Plane #52 its existence was established 26/09/2020 following the discovery of three human remains three meters away from the entrance in Plane #445. Each presented a different stage of decomposition, although all were incomplete, missing limbs or organs which were visibly cut off using crude tools or ripped through brute force. At the time of discovery, the first body was in a state of bloat, the second in a state of active decay, and the last one in a skeletonized state.
